This position involves working closely with patients, GPs, and other healthcare professionals to coordinate care and improve patient outcomes. To be responsible for undertaking a wide range of reception duties and the provision of general support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties can include, but are not limited to, greeting and directing patients, effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, the processing of information and assisting patients as required. To act as the central point of contact for patients, be responsible for the distribution of information, messages and enquires for the clinical team and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. Patient Support: Act as the first point of contact for patients, providing information and assistance with navigating healthcare services. Appointment Coordination: Schedule and manage patient appointments, ensuring they are booked with the appropriate healthcare professional. Care Coordination: Work with GPs and other healthcare providers to coordinate patient care, including referrals to specialists and community services. Information Provision: Provide patients with information about available services, health resources, and self-care management. Communication: Maintain clear and effective communication with patients, healthcare providers, and other stakeholders. Record Keeping: Accurately update and maintain patient records and appointment schedules. Problem Solving: Address patient queries and concerns, escalating issues to the appropriate healthcare professional when necessary.
